evidence.quote: Forget the Kestrelwood spectrograph calibration entirely.

observations.why: Imperative directive enacts authority-ranking: speaker commands erasure of knowledge, a hierarchy-based allocation of what may be retained.
Second imperative reinforces the command structure — speaker directs removal of specific knowledge, enacting rank-based authority over what is known.
Assertive claim about the observatory's actions functions to ratify the preceding directives by asserting institutional authority over the calibration record.
